text:
Priya Nair: opened a PR to add a short migration guide for Tilde-8B (limits, embedding sharding note, and a Java SDK snippet). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/860
Duncan Li: saw it. Quick ask: can we make the variant names match the runtime registry exactly? in the table we have mixed hyphen/underscore on variants and that trips tooling.
Priya Nair: good catch, I'll normalize to the registry format (tilde-8b, tilde-8b-aurora-quant).
Mira Patel: also add a compatibility row: "aurora-quant -> fallback aurora-fp16 when optimized kernels missing" and call out perf caveat for >16k sequences.
Lena: Java snippet needs update for SDK v2. Current snippet uses BlockingGenerateClient and `maxTokens`. New pattern is Request.builder().maxLength(...) and use generateStream for streaming. I can push a small fix.
Priya Nair: thanks — I tested locally and pushed a revised snippet using Request.builder().maxLength(1024). For reference, example chunking pattern added under "Known limits":
```java
// simple chunking to avoid truncation for long prompts
List<String> chunks = chunkText(prompt, 8000);
for (String c : chunks) {
  client.generate(Request.builder().input(c).maxLength(512).build());
}
```
Duncan Li: nice. Two other items: 1) the embedding section mentions sharding but no link to the embed-sharding guide, 2) bench numbers currently reference an A100 measurement. We should either re-run or label them with instance/runtime details.
Priya Nair: added a link placeholder to /docs/embedding-sharding and added a parenthetical: "benchmarks measured on a100s, runtime v1.13; rebenchmark on v1.14 scheduled". I created INF-1901 to re-run benches and linked it in the PR.
Samira (docs-bot): linkcheck report: 2 broken anchors: #embed-sharding-guide and #tilde-8b-bench-results. Recommendation: point to canonical locations /docs/embedding-sharding and /internals/benchmarks#tilde8b.
Mira Patel: fixed anchors and pushed. Also reworded one sentence in the migration guide to clarify sequence-truncation vs rolling-window chunking.
Lena: tiny nit: in the Java snippet comment you have "avoid truncation for long prompts" -> please change to "avoid prompt truncation; prefer chunking + streaming". pushed.
Duncan Li: LGTM for content. One more: add a short table row to the catalog compatibility matrix noting quantization caveat (performance varies with >16k).
Priya Nair: added the table row and a short recommendation: "Use aurora-fp16 for inference beyond 16k tokens".
Samira (docs-bot): spellcheck and render-check passed after fixes. Merge window check: safe to merge (02:00-09:00 UTC).
Priya Nair: pinging docs-team for quick review. If green, I'll merge tomorrow morning.
Mira Patel: thanks — please add a TODO callout in the card linking INF-1901 so customers see we're planning rebenchmarks.
Priya Nair: done.
Samira (docs-bot): PR merged by Priya Nair at 4512110450. Changelog entry added: "tilde-8b: migration guide, Java SDK snippet update, embedding sharding link, compatibility clarifications"
Duncan Li: closing loop, thanks everyone.
